data.name: Navya
data.gender_notes: Navya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nav', meaning new or young, Navya signifies the freshness and vitality of youth. In Hindu mythology, Navya is the name of a divine nymph, symbolizing renewal and regeneration. The name Navya carries the meaning “New, Fresh, Youthful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Navya usually hope their child will grow to embody new, fresh, youthful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the renewal of life and the freshness of youth
data.etymology: Navya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “New, Fresh, Youthful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Navya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
